set.body: SurfaceSceneDocument at a3ee73b captures default asset.kind but drops state.geometryPresentations; restore resets inflated/morphed states to default. Extend native versioned document/codec to preserve and validate selected Fixed/Morph presentations and bind the complete admitted geometry family, retain V1-V7 legacy default behavior, refuse missing/mismatched variants. Public API regression and JVM+JS tests required. Consumer plsneuro bd-01M2B70YQPV7PF0QVPPT14F1TJ is provenance only, no foreign blocking edge.
set.title: Preserve geometry families and selected Fixed/Morph presentation in surface scene codec
